rules.name: PA authority rate power
rules.evidence: 53 Pa.C.S. §5607(d)(9): reasonable and uniform rates within the applicable service/class framework; sufficient revenues and lawful charges.
rules.implementation: No invented statewide annual percentage cap. Class allocation is a planning assumption; cost-of-service support remains needed.

rules.name: PUC jurisdiction
rules.evidence: Municipal-authority systems are not generally regulated as investor-owned PUC water utilities. Particular statutory/contract exceptions require their own analysis.
rules.implementation: No imported investor-owned rate-case, allowed-return or automatic PUC approval rule.

rules.name: City core annual adjustment
rules.evidence: Prior June annual Northeast CPI-U, not seasonally adjusted, plus 2.5 points through 2032; nonnegative. Municipal contracts and permitted add-ons are separate.
rules.implementation: 2027 CPI 4.3% implied by published proposal; 2028–2031 CPI 3.3% assumed. Check ceiling; an explicit amendment assumption allows above-ceiling scenarios.

rules.name: City capital recovery and AO fees
rules.evidence: Published 2027 water/sewer CCRC and administrative-order rates are explicit invoice lines; eligible cost and approval treatment is separate from core rates.
rules.implementation: Existing component rates are verified. Future growth uses a 5.8% proxy; any selected uplift assumes eligibility and required approvals, without certifying them.

rules.name: 2020 concession amendments
rules.evidence: Council approval and later implementation history support operation of the amendment. The reviewed execution-copy PDF contains blank signatures.
rules.implementation: Use published operating regime for analysis. Conditional 1.70× rate relief is not imposed as a generic debt covenant or a Suburban fund floor.

rules.name: Municipal / interceptor agreements
rules.evidence: Cost allocations, debt, reserved capacity and treatment terms differ by system. WLI / LLRI 2027 rates had preliminary approval in reviewed October minutes.
rules.implementation: Keep published customer-receipt profile. Editable residual-receipt uplift assumes contractual approval; do not apply household CPI or tariff increases to the full fund.

rules.name: Industrial wastewater strength
rules.evidence: Flow, BOD, TSS, TKN, reserved capacity, sampling and permits can be separate charge drivers. Applicability depends on the service and permit.
rules.implementation: Industrial usage sensitivity remains available. No blanket strength surcharge is added to all industry; detailed fees and source thresholds are in tariff research JSON.

rules.name: Capital scope and grants
rules.evidence: Adopted plans require later annual/project and borrowing approvals; future projected grants are not automatically secured.
rules.implementation: Full detailed project schedule retained. Incremental financing is capped after planned debt, grants and existing capital receipts; timing and award sensitivities stay enabled.

rules.name: Cash, debt and covenant tests
rules.evidence: Restricted balances are excluded. Reported coverage definitions differ by fund and covenant. Published debt-service schedules do not provide a complete future principal ledger.
rules.implementation: 180 cash days and 1.20× conservative coverage are editable planning targets. Additional debt amortizes explicitly; remaining baseline debt is disclosed as not estimated.
